title: Overview
text: Ameya Agrawal — Overview Evolving synthesis of everything in the wiki. Updated by wiki-ingest when sources shift the understanding. Contents Who He Is The Arc of His Career Quantified Impact Key Entities Recurring Ideas Who He Is Ameya Agrawal is a strategy leader, social entrepreneur, author, and builder based in Pune, India. He sits at an uncommon intersection: institutional strategy (Strategy Manager / Chief of Staff at MIT World Peace University), social impact at scale (125,000+ people through MGSS, 25,000+ through SkillSlate), active intellectual output (3 Forbes India articles, blog, Medium, book), and hands-on software building (10 GitHub repos). He is an IIM Kozhikode Gold Medalist (2024) and a BE in Electronics & Telecom with Distinction (MIT COE Pune, 2016). He pursued his MBA alongside his wife Vrushali Agrawal, who was in the same cohort. A self-described "shy soul" who loves theatrical performance, he began writing at school age and holds a national record as the youngest engineering student to write a self-motivation book — A Leap Within , published at age 20–21. His decision to decline Harvard and LSE in 2021 in favour of building SkillSlate and leading MGSS is the defining biographical moment — validated by two Presidential National Awards. title: A Leap Within (Book)
text: A Leap Within Overview A Leap Within is Ameya Agrawal's debut self-help book, published by Kalpaz Publication, New Delhi in 2015. Written during his 2nd and 3rd year of engineering, it was completed over approximately 15 months . Available on Amazon and Flipkart. 1 Contents Overview Structure Reception Key Quotes from the Book Writing Motivation Goodreads He holds a national record as the youngest engineering student to write a self-motivation book — published at age 20–21. 2 "This book is By the youngster, to the youngsters and for the youngsters." 1 Structure The book is divided into 7 sections covering: 1 1. Life fundamentals 2. Understanding existence 3. Self-exploration 4. Love 5. Societal connection 6. Personality development 7. Practical lessons Includes personal stories, experiences, and motivational one-liners. Sections can be read in any order without losing coherence. 1 Reception 2,000+ copies sold 3 45 ratings on Goodreads 4 Appreciated by Radhakrishnan Pillai (author of Corporate Chanakya ) 1 Readers noted surprise at a 20-year-old tackling complex psychological topics 1 Led to speaking invitations at educational institutions across India 1 Key Quotes from the Book "What is the best thing about people doubting your potential? The pleasure of proving them wrong." 4 "When you are worried about thinking why you can't, you are losing reasons why you should." 4 "Entrepreneurship is a responsibility rather than a profession." 4 "The reason some people put on a mask is not in their blood but it is in their fear that we judge them too soon." 4 "Boss may be one, but leader can be anyone!" 4 "Hard work doesn't guarantee success, dedication and persistence do." 2 Writing Motivation "Writing that one page at a time kept me inspiring." 1 Writing started during school as a way to document feelings and thoughts. His mother preserved a 100-page early manuscript. Engineering was difficult; writing became his hope through it. 1 Goodreads Author page: goodreads.com/author/quotes/13789641.Ameya_Agrawal Followers: 18 https://www.indiacafe24.com/interviews/authors/get-motivated-with-author-ameya-agrawal/ — Full interview on the book  ↩ ↩ ↩ ↩ ↩ ↩ ↩ ↩ ↩ https://vidhyathakkar.com/interview-with-ameya-agrawal/ — Interview covering writing timeline and national record  ↩ ↩ raw/ameya-agrawal-cv.pdf — Achievements section: "sold 2000+ copies"  ↩ https://www.goodreads.com/author/quotes/13789641.Ameya_Agrawal — Quotes page  ↩ ↩ ↩ ↩ ↩ ↩

title: MGSS
text: Mahatma Gandhi Seva Sangh (MGSS) Founded: 1994, Parbhani, Maharashtra Ameya's Role: Head of Strategy and Business Development (2021–2023) Award: Best NGO in India 2022 — Department of Disabilities, Government of India See also: SkillSlate Foundation — Ameya's other flagship social initiative Contents What MGSS Does Impact Numbers The Akola Pattern National Award (2022) Ameya's Work at MGSS What MGSS Does MGSS is a nationally recognized NGO focused on disability rehabilitation and empowerment of persons with disabilities (PWDs / Divyangjan). It operates 10 District Disability Rehabilitation Centres across Maharashtra and Goa, with additional work in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab, Bihar, and West Bengal. 1 Services: - Healthcare and social services - Education and rehabilitation - Assistive device distribution - Socio-economic mapping - Government policy advocacy - Authorized ALIMCO dealer (assistive devices) Impact Numbers Initiative Number People impacted (operations) 125,000+ (under Ameya's tenure) 3 Assistive devices distributed 100,000+ individuals 1 Hearing aids (National Hearing Mission) 20,000+ individuals 1 Citizens engaged in disability project 6,000,000+ (Ameya's leadership) 3 PWDs mapped in Akola 50,000+ individuals 1 The Akola Pattern Ameya led India's first large-scale socio-economic mapping of persons with disabilities in Akola district, Maharashtra — covering 1.5 million participants . title: Recurring Themes
text: Ideas & Recurring Themes A synthesis of the ideas that appear consistently across Ameya's writing, work, and public presence. Contents 1. Leadership De-Skilling 2. Patient, Long-Term Leadership 3. AI's Threat to Indian Higher Education 4. Psychological Roots of Workplace Behavior 5. Social Impact Over Prestige 6. Inclusion and Disability Rights 7. Building Tools You Actually Use 8. Satire as Commentary 1. Leadership De-Skilling Senior leaders are losing the ability to make real decisions because systems, AI, and delegation have removed the need for judgment. Ameya calls this a "Judgment Vacuum." 1 2. Patient, Long-Term Leadership The "Farmer Leader" metaphor: great leadership requires planting seeds, accepting delayed gratification, and resisting the pressure for immediate results. 2 3. AI's Threat to Indian Higher Education Ameya argues that traditional college education in India is failing to prepare students for the AI era — 7 specific structural critiques. 2 4. Psychological Roots of Workplace Behavior Inferiority and superiority complexes, loyalty vs. merit confusion, and toxic organizational cultures all stem from deeper psychological wounds — Ameya applies behavioral science to organizational dynamics. 2 5. Social Impact Over Prestige Declining Harvard and LSE to work on SkillSlate and disability rehabilitation signals a deliberate values stance: systemic change over individual credential accumulation. 3 6. Inclusion and Disability Rights Through Mahatma Gandhi Seva Sangh, disability rehabilitation is a core commitment — 100,000+ lives impacted. 3 7. Building Tools You Actually Use His GitHub projects (brain2.0, card2contacts) are solutions to his own problems — personal knowledge management, contact workflow automation. Builder-for-self philosophy. 8. Satire as Commentary LinkedIn posts like "How to ruin your employees completely" use satire to critique toxic management — humor as a vehicle for serious organizational criticism. 4 https://blog.ameya.page — Post: "Judgment Vacuum: 5 Warning Signs Senior Leaders Are Being De-skilled" (May 1, 2026)  ↩ https://blog.ameya.page — Posts listed on homepage (Apr–May 2026)  ↩ ↩ ↩ https://ameya.page — Bio section describing Harvard/LSE decision and SkillSlate/MGSS work  ↩ ↩ https://in.linkedin.com/in/ameyaagrawal — Featured posts section  ↩
